## Files matching `agent-packages/seagull-diameter-scenarios/{apm.yml,README.md}`

## Developing seagull-diameter-scenarios

These rules apply to every change under `agent-packages/seagull-diameter-scenarios/`, in addition to the rules for all
packages.

### Names

The word order is the reverse of the one for a new package. Keep it, because renaming a command breaks it for users.

- A plain-language skill is `seagull-diameter-<verb>-<object>`, such as `seagull-diameter-extract-steps`.
- A command is `/seagull-diameter-<object>-<verb>`, such as `/seagull-diameter-steps-extract`. The settings command is
  `/seagull-diameter-settings`.

### Skills

- The `description` of a plain-language skill starts with `Use when`.
- The plain-language skill and its command link to each other.
- A command also sets `metadata.opencode/slash: "true"`.
- For the same parameters, a command and a plain request write the same files.

Shared code and the formats of the files go into the `seagull-diameter-common` skill.

The instruction that ships to users, `.apm/instructions/seagull-diameter-scenarios.instructions.md`, limits what the
agent does on its own: starting Seagull, replacing files, choosing dictionaries or placeholders. A new or changed skill
must not contradict it.

### What else changes with a new or changed task

- `PLAIN_SKILLS` in `tests/selftest_skills.py`: add the pair of the command and the plain-language skill.
- The cases in `docs/qa/test-plan.md`.

### Tests with Seagull

`tests/selftest.py` skips the runs in Seagull unless `SEAGULL_IMAGE` names a Docker image or `SEAGULL_EXE` names a
`seagull.exe` for Windows. When you report the result, say whether those runs took place.
